The adjective branch of cukra sour includes Bengali cuk/cukā acid, Assamese suksukiyā slightly acid and several northwestern cuk-/cūk- forms. Hajong cuku/cuka/cukau preserves this affricate-plus-velar sour stem with final-vowel variation. The adjective branch is used, rather than the separately defined drink or plant senses; the evidence establishes the regional family, not an independently demonstrated route for each ending.
